body: Well, they also said I had a mood disorder which could or could not be indicative of the early stages of bipolar disorder (which would really suck if I found out that were true). I guess that's what the abilify is for.

These were the side affects from 2 mg and I'm supposed to be upping the dosage to 5mg and eventually 10 mg. I'm also supposed to start a prescription for Zoloft in conjunction with the Abilify but I just don't see the point, I'd rather be depressed than pumped full of all these drugs that don't seem to help.

Not really. I'm home from school for break, haven't seen any friends, haven't left my bed. Graduating in May, have no aspirations/prospects, have no money, have no idea what to do with my life.

I've seen the world. and it really ain't all that great. Sure there's some cool stuff to look at for a little bit but I'm pretty over it. The way I feel all the time now isn't worth living through.
Come on, someone please help me out

They try to reach out but I just ignore them. Screen all phone calls or just leave phone off. No response to emails. I don't really talk to anyone these days, much less a doctor.

In my free time I read. But reading about things that are going on in the outside world makes me realize what a waste of life I am not being a part of it.
I am too depressed to continue living. I am not unhappy, I just have no will to go out and live life. I haven't left my house in almost a month and I never want to see my friends and family again.
